stem.text: An aircraft travels along a horizontal path. Two of the forces that act horizontally on the aircraft are the thrust force of the engines and the force due to the wind. The vector diagram for these forces is shown.

stem.alt: Vector diagram: a horizontal arrow pointing left, labelled thrust force of the engines, and an arrow pointing up and to the right from the same starting point, labelled force due to the wind.

stem.text: Which vector represents the resultant horizontal force acting on the aircraft due to these two forces?

A.alt: Straight arrow pointing up and to the right.

B.alt: Straight arrow pointing down and to the left.

C.alt: Straight arrow pointing up and to the left.

D.alt: Straight arrow pointing down and to the right.
